meta_title: Paul Keenan Painting & Decorating | Newcastle Painter
meta_description: Paul Keenan Painting and Decorating in Newcastle. Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decorating. Free quotes. Call 07930 664304.
hero_eyebrow: Local Newcastle Painter — Quality Finishes, Fair Prices
hero_subhead: From tired walls to stunning interiors. We transform homes across Newcastle with precision painting and decorating that lasts.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: Whether you need a single room refreshed or a full house transformation, we handle interior and exterior projects with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Transform living spaces with perfectly prepared walls and ceilings. We use premium paints to deliver a lasting, professional finish in your chosen colours.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Protect and refresh your home's exterior. From woodwork to masonry, we prepare surfaces thoroughly and apply weather-resistant coatings that stand up to Newcastle's climate.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Expert pattern matching and fitting. We hang all types of wallpaper — from classic to contemporary — with precision edges and no bubbles or creases.

services.title: Woodwork Decoration
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, and fitted furniture deserve skilled attention. We sand, prime, and paint to achieve a smooth, durable finish.

services.title: Damp & Preparation
services.desc: Poor prep ruins any finish. We investigate damp issues, repair plasterwork, and prepare surfaces properly so paint adheres and lasts years longer.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Offices, retail units, and rental properties need quick, reliable work. We schedule efficiently and minimise disruption to your business.

about_pullquote: I'd rather do one job brilliantly than rush through ten badly.
about_para_1: Paul Keenan Painting and Decorating has been transforming homes across Newcastle for 18 years. What started as one man with a paintbrush and a van has grown into a trusted local business, built on honest pricing and meticulous attention to detail. Paul oversees every project personally, ensuring standards never slip.
about_para_2: Homeowners return to us because we show up on time, explain what we're doing, and leave your home spotless. We don't cut corners with undercoats or cheap paint — and we're happy to discuss costs upfront so there are no surprises. That's why repeat customers and referrals make up most of our work.

reviews.text: Paul came recommended by a friend and he's brilliant. Did my lounge and hallway — the prep work was thorough and the finish is immaculate. Didn't leave a mess and cleaned up after himself. Fair price too. Definitely booking him for the bedrooms.
reviews.author: Claire T.

reviews.text: Needed the exterior of my Victorian terrace painted. Paul was honest about what needed doing, didn't oversell anything, and got it done in two weeks. The masonry looks properly sealed now and he's left all the gutters and downpipes spotless. Top job.
reviews.author: Michael P.

reviews.text: Wallpapered three rooms for us. Paul was meticulous with pattern matching — you'd never know where the joins are. He worked around our furniture without fuss and even helped us move a bookshelf back in. Would have him back in a heartbeat.
reviews.author: Sarah J.
